prompt_en: Create a photographic sports scene of a participating athlete engaged in play. Use the supplied portrait as the appearance reference for her dark brown eyes, short dark bob with a wispy fringe, softly rounded face and natural skin texture. On a green indoor badminton court, she reaches a low shuttle beside the net in a deep forward lunge, trying to keep a delicate exchange alive. Her racket-side foot is the forward planted support toward the net, its knee bent above the shoe; her lowered torso reaches on that same racket side, her rear leg stretches behind with the forefoot on the floor, and her free arm opens behind her for balance. The racket hand closes around a wrapped handle. A single slender shaft continues from that handle to one closed oval rim enclosing a crossed string bed; this same racket head is held below one feathered shuttle, leaving a clear small gap between cork and strings at this pre-contact instant. The shuttle has a small rounded cork at its narrow end, separate feather stems joining that base and spreading outward, and broad feather tips opening into a conical crown at the opposite end, distinct from the cork. Her eyes stay on that gap, lips slightly parted with concentration. A faint flush and loose fringe give the face the warmth of someone wholly inside the game. She wears a pale coral short-sleeved athletic shirt, navy shorts and white indoor court shoes. A white net tape divides the near court from the far half, where one softly rendered opponent waits with a lowered racket. From the sideline, a three-quarter view keeps her face, both shoes, racket head and shuttle in one readable full-body frame with space around the contact area. The extended lunge runs across the frame; the complete near racket and shuttle occupy clear central space, and moderate depth of field resolves her face, the crossing strings and the shuttle parts together. Broad overhead hall light gives soft shadows across the matte floor and restrained highlights on the strings. The face and shuttle are the main points of attention, while worn court lines and the far player's quiet readiness make the effort feel part of a real rally. Render as a natural editorial photograph with crisp physical detail and modest motion in the loose hair.
